question: Given a target class, can a learner that sees only the lines at a hole reach it on class-forced tori and grown tori, at what cost, and which class do learners without a target reach?

public_inputs.spaces: torus(N, 1, 1) for N = 4..40 even and the two Fano tori (handles_lib); the 60 grown tori of GROW-HANDLE-20261110-001A grown at the dissonance (K_2-K_4, every line orbit, both chiralities, the three torus bijections), built by grow_lib.
public_inputs.starts: thin and Fano: the first 50 starts per torus of LEARN-HANDLES-20261109-001A check 5 as regenerated by NATIVE-TARGET-20261110-001A's run.py starts(); grown: the extended flat state of each space with a split side drawn from random.Random(1110).
public_inputs.C7: target class c (outside). acc = class contribution of the sign changes made so far (sum of each re-signed side's two class-functional bits). First hole (nearer w0 by graph distance): moves to the candidate nearest w0 by graph distance; second hole: to the candidate whose (face, acc after the move) is nearest, in the four-sheeted cover of the triangulation's 1-skeleton defined by the class functionals, to (w0, the class change c minus the forced class); never straight back unless forced; random ties; budget 50 V^2. Success: resolved with class c.
public_inputs.untargeted: R0 and R3 of NATIVE-TARGET-20261110-001A run.py from the same starts; the class reached read from the replayed sign change.
public_inputs.cheapest: handles_lib.Torus.cheapest_matching into each class, 1 + its moves.

forbidden_inputs: Changing rules, budgets, starts or seeds after seeing results
primary_observable: Per space and target class: C7 runs reaching c, mean re-signings, and the cheapest walk; the share of R0 and R3 runs ending in the short class (lower bound 2) on thin tori.
cheapest_meaningful_control: R0 and R3 without a target (the default class).
decision_or_followup_rule: Q2 holds if C7 reaches every target from every start and its mean re-signings are at most twice the mean cheapest walk into that class on every space; Q3 holds if R0 and R3 each end in the short class in more than 80% of runs on every thin torus of at least 20 points; Q4 holds if C7 reaches every class on every grown torus in at most 10 re-signings.
stop_rule: Stop at the declared spaces, starts and rules.
nonclaims: The target class and all graph distances are supplied from outside (A26).
No claim about minds or decisions in general.
